references.text: Psalm 107:23–32 describes those who go out to sea and experience storms and dangers, which recalls the event in Mark 4:37 where the disciples encounter a great storm on the sea.

In Isaiah 43:2 it is said that when you walk through water, I will be with you, and through rivers, they shall not overwhelm you. This can be seen as a parallel to the safety Jesus provides in the storm in Mark 4:37.
Matthew 8:23–27 also tells the story of Jesus calming the storm, which is a direct parallel event to Mark 4:37.
Luke 8:22–25 gives another account of Jesus calming the storm, paralleling the event in Mark 4:37.
